line: Dive headfirst, deep in that water like Michael Phelps
vault_lines: Dive headfirst, deep in that water like Michael Phelps
meaning:
Michael Phelps (b. June 30, 1985, Baltimora) is a former American swimmer, often considered as the greatest champion of all the time in his field, as he won 83 medals during his career, 66 of which were gold medals (23 at the Olympic Games, 26 at the World Aquatics Championships).



In reality, Phelps wasn’t really a specialist in free-diving, as he mainly focused on the classic competitive swimming, but still, here Polo G chooses his figure as a good starting reference to the enormous amount of risks the artists involved in the song and their friends took during their lives, often without being sure of preserving their health or their relationships.

line: (DJ Victoriouz with me in the building)
vault_lines: Dive headfirst, deep in that water like Michael Phelps
meaning: This is the producer tag for Chicago-based producer DJ Victoriouz. While he previously has worked with G Herbo on multiple tracks, “All In” marks his first collaboration with Clever and Polo G.
